# Belief { #timetoalign.core.Belief }

```python
core.Belief()
```

One actor's belief in an item, at a date.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| actor  | [str](`str`)                                             | Who holds the belief (an IRI or another identifier of a person). |
| belief | [BeliefValue](`timetoalign.core.provenance.BeliefValue`) | ``"true"``, ``"false"`` or ``"unlikely"``.                       |
| date   | [str](`str`)                                             | When the actor stated it, written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.                |
| note   | [str](`str`) \| None                                     | Optional free text.                                              |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> Belief(actor="https://orcid.org/0000-0001", belief="false", date="2026-11-21")
Belief(actor='https://orcid.org/0000-0001', belief='false', date='2026-11-21', note=None)
```

| --- | --- |

| [to_dict](#timetoalign.core.Belief.to_dict) | The belief as a JSON-safe dictionary, an absent ``note`` left out. |
